Hi Kiran — looping in Revenue Ops (cc'd) and adding the compliance checklist so we have an audit trail. A few notes from legal/tax: 

- Reverse-charge is fine for B2B services where the buyer is established in the EU and has a valid EU VAT ID. We will need the confirmed VAT ID, the country of registration, and the effective date for each entity (we need this to support any reissued creditnotes).
- For hosted invoices (self-serve customers) we can add a tax-override tag per invoice via the API; for enterprise billing we can apply line-level tax codes which show on the PDF.
- If your ERP cannot import line-level taxes, a pragmatic path is to issue a credit and reissue two invoices: one with reverse-charge line-items (zero VAT) and the remaining non-eligible lines with VAT charged. That keeps your GL clean.

Can you confirm the two VAT IDs in the certificate and the preferred remediation approach (API flag vs. reissue)? If you choose reissue, please confirm the period you want corrected (e.g., Nov 2026).
